name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux from PyPI through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc28): adding a step to an existing approval map now works on older Acumatica builds, where it had been failing outright. The message it gave was the misleading part - it said nothing had been saved, when the step had in fact been created correctly and the tool simply could not see it afterwards, so it gave up and reported failure. Only that one operation was affected; everything else worked on those builds throughout. This also ships an audit of the knowledge base the server consults before every write: its recorded findings were re-checked against a live older instance, which confirmed most of them and corrected three. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
